# Spatial outputs {#sec-maps}

:::{.aside}
```{r}
#| eval: true
#| code-fold: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-summary: Setup for this R session
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ecoSynthesis)
library(geco)
library(fasterize)

here::i_am("synthesis/EFG-map.qmd")
output_dir <- here::here("output-XREFs")
load(here::here(output_dir, "memb-tables.rda"))
out_dir <- here::here("gisout")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
    dir.create(out_dir)
}
efg_pixel_values <- geco_efg_data() |>
    select(efg_code, efg_pixel_value) |>
    rename("EFG" = "efg_code")
```

:::

In order to create spatial outputs from the synthesis of membership values, we need to combine the membership table with the spatial attribute table.

The spatial attribute table attached to the spatial dataset (in Shapefile format) contains one entry per polygon, and hundred of thousands of polygons.

```{r}
TASVEG_xy <- read_sf(here::here("gisdata", "LIST_TASVEG_50_STATEWIDE", "TASVEG_5_0.shp"))

TASVEG_xy |>
    st_drop_geometry()
```

The decisions about how we synthetise the data will constrain the type of data we can export as output. Here we show certain examples.

## Best candidates from aggregated membership

Here we aggregate the data from the second round of expert elicitation.

```{r}
TASVEG_best_summary <-
    summarise_membership(TASVEG_clean, keep_all = FALSE, which_round = 2)
```

Then we combine this dataset with the spatial table and a 
```{r}
TASVEG_xy_best <- TASVEG_xy |>
    left_join(TASVEG_best_summary, by = "VEGCODE", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
    left_join(efg_pixel_values, by = "EFG")
```

```{r}
nrow(TASVEG_xy_best) == nrow(TASVEG_xy)
TASVEG_xy_best |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    select(VEG_GROUP, VEGCODE, EFG, prop_memb, supporting, efg_pixel_value) |>
    slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
rez <- 90
TASVEG_raster <- raster(TASVEG_xy, res = rez)
memb_raster <- fasterize(
    TASVEG_xy_best,
    TASVEG_raster,
    field = "prop_memb",
    fun = "max"
) |> rast()
target_raster <- fasterize(
    TASVEG_xy_best,
    TASVEG_raster,
    field = "efg_pixel_value",
    fun = "first"
) |> rast()
supp_raster <- fasterize(
    TASVEG_xy_best,
    TASVEG_raster,
    field = "supporting",
    fun = "max"
) |> rast()

ctab <- data.frame(value = 1:5, color = wesanderson::wes_palette("Moonrise3"))
coltab(supp_raster) <- ctab
plot(supp_raster)

ctab <- geco_efg_data() |> transmute(value = efg_pixel_value, color = efg_hex_code)
coltab(target_raster) <- ctab
plot(target_raster)
plot(memb_raster)
out_file <- here::here(out_dir, "TASVEG-xref-target.tiff")

rast_metadata <- c(
    PROJECT = "Ecosystem Indicators Workflows",
    TITLE = "Best candidate ecosystem function group",
    DESCRIPTION = "Synthesis of crossreference from TASVEG to IUCN GET"
)
metags(target_raster) <- rast_metadata

writeRaster(target_raster,
    out_file,
    overwrite = TRUE
)
```

## Combining 

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| output: false
tas_all <- rast(dir(out_dir, pattern = "res90", full.names = TRUE))
tas_which <- app(tas_all, fun = "which.max", na.rm = T)
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
plot(tas_which)
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| output: false
tas_max <- app(tas_all, fun = "max", na.rm = T)
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
plot(tas_max)
```
